steps: Analyze the question: Identify the green, expanded part of a leaf containing veins and veinlets.
Check Option (A): Petiole is the stalk connecting the leaf to the stem, not the expanded part.
Check Option (B): Node is the point on the stem where the leaf attaches, not a part of the leaf.
Check Option (C): Stipules are small appendages at the base of the petiole, not the main expanded blade.
Check Option (D): Lamina (leaf blade) is the broad, green, expanded part of the leaf with veins and veinlets.
Therefore, Lamina is the correct answer.
